changes.text: Terra Volta – fixed a location where a player could fall through the world.
Fixed issue with certain Circle of Thorns maps where a player could fall through the world.
Adjusted villain spawns in prison rooms to keep them from trapping players in the cells.
Moved several Circle of Thorns crystals in mission maps to keep the player from being interrupted while trying to achieve a nearby objective.
Modified Lightning Storm so it can be summoned in the Air, increased its fire rate and Range, and it now accepts Range Enhancements.
Fixed a bug when in certain situations removing a temporary power could deactivate auto powers for a short period.
Fixed a bug when in certain situations a summoned pet could turn evil.
Fixed a graphics glitch that would cause a client crash in the Abandoned Sewer Network for certain hardware configurations.
